summary: FingerMotion, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a $5.0M senior secured convertible note issuance to an institutional investor. The note carries a $700K original issue discount, no interest except on default, matures May 2027, and is convertible at $0.94/share or via monthly redemption conversions at a variable price subject to a floor. A resale registration covering 200% of conversion shares is contingent upon SEC effectiveness, with $1.0M of proceeds held back. This is a structured financing with significant dilution and variable pricing, not a special situation.
